episodes.name: Jordan Park
episodes.quote: Every piece I make starts with a question I don’t have an answer to yet. The clay helps me find my way toward something.

episodes.name: Sam Reyes
episodes.quote: Community is where the work comes from. I don’t know if I’d make anything if there wasn’t someone to share it with.

episodes.name: Maya Osei
episodes.quote: You can pull twenty prints from the same plate and each one is slightly different. It’s never quite the same twice.
